questions.question: How did demonetisation act as a catalyst for the growth of digital / payments in India?

  • encouraging use of digital wallets and UPI. It accelerated fintech growth and financial literacy, paving
  • the way for India’s transition toward a cash-light economy.

  • banks and apps seamlessly. Unlike card-based or wallet systems, UPI ensures open access, scalability
  • and security, making it a global benchmark in digital payments.
